# Sourcely

> AI-powered academic source finder that helps researchers discover peer-reviewed papers, generate citations, and streamline their research workflow.

Sourcely is an intelligent research assistant built by NYU founders that leverages AI to search millions of academic sources and provide citation management across multiple formats. The platform offers both free and premium subscription tiers with features like Deep Search for discovering relevant peer-reviewed papers and automated citation generation.

## Key Topics

- AI Research Assistant
- Academic Source Discovery
- Deep Search
- Citation Management
- Peer-Reviewed Papers
- BibTeX & Citation Formats
- Source Finding
- Research Tools
- Citation Generation

- Premium Features
- Student-Focused
- Semantic Search
- Google Scholar Integration
- Research Workflow

## Core Features

- [Sourcely | Find Academic Sources with AI](https://www.sourcely.net): AI-powered academic source finder for papers, citations, and research.
- [Deep Academic Search | Sourcely](https://www.sourcely.net/deep-search): Deep Search feature for discovering peer-reviewed academic sources.
- [Find Research Papers with AI | Sourcely](https://www.sourcely.net/find-research-papers): AI-powered search across millions of peer-reviewed academic papers.
- [AI Research Assistant for Academic Writing | Sourcely](https://www.sourcely.net/ai-research-assistant): AI research assistant for source discovery and citation generation.
